meta.name: General integers · heuristic · L(1/3)
meta.regime: General-purpose factorization; no special low-degree polynomial form supplied
meta.rules: Heuristic subexponential general-purpose factoring bounds. Here L_X[α,c] = exp((c+o(1))(ln X)^α(ln ln X)^(1−α)); all logarithms in this definition are natural. Only compare entries with this cost scale, input domain and computational model. Polynomial and quasi-polynomial expressions without an extracted scalar are not ranked.
